mandate: C312 — test the USDT-M LINEAR CROSS-SECTIONAL order-flow-imbalance (OFI) carry family at NATIVE 5m (504 pre-registered configs) on real USDT-M 5m klines (taker buy/sell split; the ~52 GB aggTrades archive is not streamed) with linear settlement PnL notional*(exit/entry-1)*weight. This removes the inverse-settlement convexity confound that dominated C310 (0.912) and C311 (0.975), so any edge is attributable to OFI carry. Multiple-testing (Holm+BH over 504 configs), DSR/MDE given the WF splits, sub-period + per-year (2023/2024/2025) stability, per-asset attribution over 10 perps, and USDT-M execution-cost-realism overlay (taker 5bps / maker 2bps + 1bps slippage on turnover).

methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs equal-weight B&H (0 bps); Holm step-down and Benjamini-Hochberg step-up over 504 pre-registered configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.stability: split assigned to sub-period by test-window midpoint bar; stable iff exposure>0, net_sum>0, net_mean>B&H and net_mean>0 within the sub-period.
methodology.attribution: per-asset OOS contribution = sum(pos*lin_ret) [linear-settlement PnL]; because settlement is linear there is NO convexity term, so the OFI-carry share is 1.0 by construction.
methodology.linear_settlement: exact linear-settlement return (exit-entry)/entry; no convexity term (contrast C310/C311 inverse 1/entry-1/exit convexity).
methodology.cost_realism: one-way USDT-M cost on turnover: realistic = taker 5bps + slippage 1bps = 6bps; also reported at taker 5bps and maker 2bps. USDT-M funding excluded (control leg only, unreachable in this environment).

slimmed.reason: per-split OOS net-mean series summarized by oos_net_mean; keeps the sweep artifact under the 100 MB GitHub push limit.
